info.title: Yapper community API
info.description: First conversation contract. Event WebSocket uses yapper.v1 and a single-use yapper.ticket.<ticket> subprotocol. Mutation Origin must match installation origin. Development uses yapper_guest cookie; HTTPS uses __Host-yapper_guest.
